title: The Dark Truth About Practical Magic #Shorts
description:
Reproduction explains more of Practical Magic than any philosophy dares to admit. Practical Magic is a 1998 American fantasy romantic comedy drama film based on the 1995 novel by Alice Hoffman. The film was directed by Griffin Dunne and stars Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman, Dianne Wiest, Stockard Channing, and Aidan Quinn.

Practical Magic did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. The film was released on VHS and DVD in the United States on February 16, 1999, by Warner Home Video. A 4K Ultra HD Blu-ray was released on August 25, 2026, from Warner Bros.
